remarks: Welcome to Briarwood, a serene and intimate condominium community that offers the convenience of being near everything Norwalk has to offer. This tri-level home features newly installed engineered wood flooring on the main floor, hallways, and the finished lower level. The kitchen has been upgraded with modern cabinets and countertops, providing a fresh and contemporary feel. In the main floor living room, enjoy cozy winter evenings by the wood-burning fireplace, or take advantage of the outdoor patio during the summer months. The property offers ample storage space, including a one-car attached garage equipped with an EV charger. Located near the Metro-North and within walking distance of shops and restaurants, this home combines comfort with convenience.
